caption: The drawing depicts a costume consisting of a fitted blue long-sleeved top with black decorative lines and buttons, and cream-colored trousers. The top has a high white ruffled collar and matching blue cuffs, also accented with black lines. The bodice of the top is tailored, flaring out slightly at the waist with a pointed section at the center front. The trousers are plain and close-fitting, colored in a light cream shade. Above and to the right of the main costume, there is a smaller, less detailed sketch of the same outfit showing the back view. The background of the drawing is light beige, and the artist's signature is present in the lower right corner.
title: Child's Trousers and Top
